description: Make copies of a sample slide follow its revised design: box, shapes added or removed, fill, outline, tables, text formatting; each copy keeps its text, values and pictures. Per copy: what changed, what could not follow and why, new overflows. One undo step.

copies.description: Default every slide made from it (its layout, its shapes' ids and names).

remove.description: Copy shapes the sample lacks: auto (those most copies have) deleted, all, or none.

sample_doc.description: The sample's deck when another, d2.

name: ppt_follow_sample
